$description: Himma type scale, option 'compact', approved 2026-10-20. Rubik for Arabic and Latin with the same values. Size in sp (scales with the system text size), lineHeight as a multiplier (Flutter TextStyle.height). 'material' is the suggested M3 TextTheme slot. Reference prototype: brand/exploration/round-4/foundations.html.

title.use: section headers: Weekly plan, Habits today

body.use: habit names, lists, explanations. Names use strongWeight

caption.use: details and small counters, in the muted color

textScale.note: All text follows the system text size up to 200%, except timer digits (up to 120%) and the labels under bottom-navigation icons and step squares (up to 130%).
